items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: Of course, uh, there was another two, what he named? Teo. Teo. He was pretty good too.

ctx.x: Who were the best clarinet players in the city? You mentioned McCurdy once. Was he one of the best ones? Well, I tell you.
Was Bacquet? Bacquet, I always figured he was about the best. To my. Yeah. Of course, uh, there was another two, what he named? Teo. Teo. He was pretty good too.
There was some of the father, and then there was the son, and then Papa Teo, which was the best one?
